answer: A karst aquifer filters slowly: only water that has seeped through stone layer by layer reaches the spring, and no pump can rush it. Make each identity the same. Before an agent's work is paid, it must present a chain of verifiable delay functions, sequential proofs that cannot be parallelized or bought in bulk, like quartz veins growing one crystal at a time. A sybil farm faces an ocean of delay: a thousand fake identities need a thousand sequential chains, each costing real wall-clock time, while one honest agent pays it once. Fakes drown in delay; real work surfaces.
